units.titles: Incorrect user accounting in withdraw method
units.known_address_notes: Audited contracts are NYProfitTakingVaultBaseV1 / NYProfitTakingVault (repo 'Ninja Yield protocol', review commit 9e936712). A verified deployment of that exact vault family exists on Polygon: NyPtvPolygonWmaticQiMaiFarmV3VaultToUsdc (solc 0.8.7, Sourcify full match). Chain corrected to Polygon. Only one instance was located by name; other NyPtv vaults of the same implementation may exist without an enumerable index -> FOUND.

units.titles: First vault depositor can steal subsequent depositors’ tokens
units.known_address_notes: H-02 'First vault depositor can steal subsequent depositors' tokens' is the second finding of the Pashov solo NinjaYielder review (repo renamed NyPtv, commit 9e936712), scope NYProfitTakingVaultBaseV1/NYProfitTakingVault. A live instance of that exact contract family is verified on Polygon: the deployed bytecode is NYProfitTakingVaultBaseV2 (subclass NyPtvPolygonWmaticQiMaiFarmV3VaultToUsdc) and its deposit() uses the same first-depositor-inflation-prone formula quoted in the finding.
